findings.reason: I checked the code: no existing test injects a TestLogger into NewLoggerMiddleware, so the claimed silent-zero-calls failure is hypothetical, though returning a fresh logger from the fake is a minor design wart. The test-gap half is real but weak, since the moved attributes still reach the log through ContextualLoggerMiddleware (which runs before LoggerMiddleware) and tracing registers a provider that keeps traceID.
